note: Real export shipments confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with destination and HS code — not website claims. Exports are air-cargo consignments of rotary screen-printing machinery and parts (HS 84431990) from Ahmedabad to Ghana, Thailand and DR Congo, latest 2026-01-28, B/L nos. 9137119, 9930519, 6872509. Declared HS in the batch (390769;591000;844319) does not match the observed export HS 84431990 (printing machinery) — per project rules this is NOT a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the actual code should be corrected to 84431990 (with 85049090 seen on the import side for electronic cards from Goebel Elektronik GmbH, Germany). Role: manufacturer_trader — it both imports components (Goebel Elektronik GmbH, 21+8 shipments) and exports finished machines.
